name: VantageAds
summary: InMobi Vantage iOS SDK for header bidding via Prebid Server
description:
VantageAds is an iOS SDK that enables publishers to monetize their apps by running
a header bidding auction through InMobi's Prebid Server and rendering the winning
ad using InMobi's ad SDK. Supports Banner, Interstitial, and Rewarded ad formats.
